questions.question:
**A sentence has been given in Direct/Indirect Speech. Out of the four given alternatives, select the one which best expresses the same sentence in Indirect/Direct Speech.**

Sneha said, “I am buying a gaming console today.”

options.text: Sneha said that she is buying a gaming console today.
Sneha says she was buying a gaming console that day.
Sneha say that she is buying a gaming console on today.
Sneha said that she was buying a gaming console that day.

questions.solution:
The correct sentence in indirect speech is** 'Sneha said that she was buying a gaming console that day.'**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• In Direct speech, the actual words of the speaker are quoted within quotation marks.
 
• In Indirect speech, we report someone else’s statement in our own words.
 
• When we change the speech from Direct to Indirect, we drop the quotation marks and use the conjunction '**that'** before the Indirect statement. We make suitable changes in tenses as well.
 
• A simple present becomes a simple past:
 
 
• Drinks --> drank
 
 
 
• A present continuous becomes a past continuous:
 
 
• Is drinking --> was drinking
 
 
 
• A present perfect becomes a past perfect:
 
 
• Has eaten --> had eaten
 
 
 
• A simple past becomes a past perfect:
 
 
• Ate --> had eaten
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Also, *am* **changes to** *was*, *today* **changes to** *that day, **now* **changes to** *then*, *tomorrow* **changes to** *the next day, *etc.
 
• So, keeping these points in mind, the sentence in the question, when changed from Direct to Indirect speech, becomes: *Sneha said that she was buying a gaming console that day.*

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 4**.

questions.question:
**A sentence has been given in Active/Passive Voice. Out of the four given alternatives, select the one which best expresses the same sentence in Passive/Active Voice.**

The boss made the assistant work late.

options.text: The assistant was made to work late by the boss.
The assistant is being urged to work late.
The assistant was make to work late by the boss.
The assistant is working late due to the boss.

questions.solution:
The correct sentence in passive voice is '**The assistant was made to work late by the boss.'**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• In the given sentence, the subject is *someone* that works on the object.
 
• A sentence is said to be in Active Voice when the subject performs the action.
 
• When the subject is being acted upon by the verb – it is Passive Voice.
 
 
• The sequence in Active voice – Subject + verb + object
 
• The sequence in Passive voice – Object + verb + Subject
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The meaning conveyed by the sentence in both voices will remain the same, only the sequence of the subject and the object (or the action) changes.
 
• Let us understand this through an example
 
 
• **Active Voice:** *She kept the book in the cupboard.*
 
• **Passive Voice:** *The book was kept in the cupboard by her.*
 
 
 
• Note that 'kept' changes to 'was kept'.
 
• The given sentence is in Active Voice as somebody is the subject performing an action.
 
• The sentence when converted in Passive voice becomes:
 
 
• *The assistant was made to work late by the boss.*
 
 

*Therefore, the correct answer is **option 1**.*

questions.question: If the velocity of a body is halved its kinetic energy ________.
questions.solution:
__**CONCEPT**__**:** 

__
 
• **Velocity**: The **rate of change of displacement** is called **velocity**.

 
 
• It is denoted by V and **SI unit** is **m/s**.
 
 
 
• **Kinetic energy**: The **energy of a particle** **due to its motion** is called **kinetic energy**.
 
 
• It is denoted by KE, and the **SI unit **is the **joule (J)**.
 
 
 
• **Kinetic energy** is given by:

K.E = (1)/(2)m{v²}

Where m is the mass of the body.

**CALCULATION**__:

 
• Kinetic energy is given by:

Rightarrow K.E = (1)/(2)m{v²}

 
• So, if we substitute (1)/(2)v instead of v, then we will obtain

Rightarrow K.E₁=(1)/(2)mtimes({(1)/(2)v)²}=(1)/(2)mtimes(1)/(4){v²} = (1)/(4)( {K.E} )

 
• Hence** the kinetic energy becomes a quarter of the original**. So option 2 is correct.
